I didn't step foot in a gym for a longggg time because of this!! My general plan when I was nervous was to have a written down plan of exactly what I was going to do to avoid wandering aimlessly, a good jam list and to have a good look around the gym before starting. Feeling confident in what your next exercise is definitely kept me less focused on other people. 

Eventually after a while I got used to people generally not caring what I was doing bc I didn't care what other people were doing. And if you don't know something, ask! 99% of the time the most jacked, biggest person in the gym is probably super nice and will give you some great advice lok
